strings.name: Martha Nussbaum
strings.role: Philosopher · Scholar of law and ethics
strings.summary: Nussbaum moved from classics into ethics and political philosophy, teaching at Harvard and Brown before working in law and ethics at Chicago. In dialogue with Amartya Sen and others on the capabilities approach, she evaluates development and justice through people's actual opportunities. She also studies emotion, literature, gender, education and animal rights. The Fragility of Goodness and Women and Human Development connect classical thought with contemporary problems; her honors include the Kyoto and Holberg prizes.
